hooks.command: if ! make test; then echo 'Unit tests failed - commit blocked. Fix tests before committing (see CONTRIBUTING.md).' >&2; exit 2; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | grep -E 'prompts/.*\.jinja2$' >/dev/null && echo '{"systemMessage": "Prompt template changed - run make evals, and if the regression is deliberate, make evals_baseline (see CONTRIBUTING.md)."}' || true
